svg.title: How the AuthMethodGroups runbook works
svg.desc: A four-phase runbook. It connects and validates permissions, collects users and the registration report read-only, classifies each in-scope user into one sign-in method group by their strongest method and verifies coverage and partition, then reconciles membership of the assigned groups you made, adding and removing only in apply mode and never creating or deleting a group.
